1945, Oct. 24
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N. Y.
St. Raphael's Day Oct 24- 1945.
Dear Mrs. Winke: God bless you and yours. I have just read and noted your pathetic letter of the 19th and thank you for same -- having enrolled you for your balky knee. I am inclosing a Sacred Heart (blessed) to place on your knee and I hope that our dear Lord may smile at you and cure the "old knee."
God bless you again -- it just struck Il p.m. Thanks be to God for all things.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
(another sheet included with the above)
Rational Creature! Your purpose? ... Why did God make you? ; ? . Ah! My blue-print primary purpose .
God made me to know Him. - - O what a bles'd aim!
To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same
It's Heaven- begun -- for the grate-
Ful -- on Earth! --
To treasure aright! ? !! !
Highest Heaven it's worth
(God Himself the reward.
(even here) .
Original in Possession of :
Helen Winke
7444 Asbury Park
Detroit, MI. 48228
